newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.3017 on Friday from Thursday's 8.3020 against the U.S. dollar on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market in extremely dull trading, traders said.

Although the yuan continued its uptrend today, dull trading because of a National Day holiday limited its room to rise, they said. The market will trade on Saturday but will close from Sunday to next Wednesday because of the holiday.
The yuan opened unchanged at an intra-day low of 8.3020 and stuck to a narrow range between the opening level and a high of 8.3015 for most of the session. Most trade was done at 8.3017.
"Few wanted to trade before the four-day holiday," one trader said. "This caused the rate to move in a narrow range in dull trading."
Although trading will continue on Saturday, traders expect little movement of the rates.
The yuan closed up at 7.4858 from 7.5061 against 100 Japanese yen and up slightly at 1.0727 from 1.0731 against the Hong Kong dollar.
